# robinhood-chain-sdk

> Official TypeScript SDK for the Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) API — EVM-native on-chain trading intelligence.

## What is Robinhood Chain?

Robinhood Chain (RHC) is an Arbitrum Orbit L2, chain id 4663. MadeOnSol (https://madeonsol.com/robinhood) runs a self-hosted node and exposes EVM-native intelligence over the same paid v1 API and the same `msk_` API key as the Solana product — bundled into every tier at no extra cost. All addresses are lowercase `0x`, amounts are `eth_amount`, transactions are `tx_hash`, and blocks are `block_number`.

- **KOL Trades**: live buy/sell feed from tracked Solana KOLs' verified EVM wallets, a KOL activity leaderboard, consensus "hot tokens" (2+ KOLs), and per-KOL profiles.
- **Tokens**: token discovery, per-token snapshot (price/MC/FDV/peak/drawdown, deployer reputation, KOL activity, pools), 1-minute OHLC candles, KOL consensus (`net_flow_eth`), early-buyer quality (0–100), and same-block launch-bundle detection.
- **DEX Trade Tape**: every Uniswap v2/v3/v4 swap with the real trader EOA (tx.from), gas/ordering for MEV analysis, and KOL/deployer flags.
- **Deployer Hunter**: reputation leaderboard + per-deployer profiles (graduation = $40K peak MC, runner = $100K).
- **Alpha Wallets**: smart-money ranking by realized on-chain performance (net ETH, win rate, memecoin share), with bot-fleet flagging.
- **Streaming**: managed WebSocket for `rhc:kol_trades` and `rhc:trades`.

## Installation

```
npm install robinhood-chain-sdk
```

## Authentication

Get a free API key at https://madeonsol.com/developer (starts with `msk_`).

```typescript
import { RobinhoodClient } from "robinhood-chain-sdk";
const client = new RobinhoodClient({ apiKey: "msk_your_api_key_here" });
```

## Methods (all 14 endpoints)

### KOL (client.kol) — BASIC
- `client.kol.feed(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/feed — live KOL trade feed
- `client.kol.leaderboard(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/leaderboard — KOL activity leaderboard
- `client.kol.hotTokens(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/hot-tokens — tokens bought by 2+ KOLs
- `client.kol.wallet(wallet)` — GET /rhc/kol/{wallet} — single KOL profile

### DEX tape (client.trades) — PRO+
- `client.trades(params?)` — GET /rhc/trades — Uniswap v2/v3/v4 trade tape

### Tokens (client.tokens)
- `client.tokens.list(params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens — token discovery (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.get(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address} — token snapshot (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.candles(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/candles — 1m OHLC (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.kolConsensus(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/kol-consensus (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.buyerQuality(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/buyer-quality (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.bundle(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/bundle — launch-bundle detection (BASIC)

### Deployer Hunter (client.deployerHunter) — BASIC
- `client.deployerHunter.leaderboard(params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/leaderboard
- `client.deployerHunter.profile(address)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/{address}

### Alpha Wallets (client.alphaWallets) — PRO+
- `client.alphaWallets(params?)` — GET /rhc/alpha-wallets — smart-money ranking

### Streaming (client.stream) — PRO+
- `client.stream.getToken()` — POST /stream/token — 24h WS token
- `client.stream.connect()` — managed WebSocket (channels: rhc:kol_trades, rhc:trades)

## Error handling

All methods throw `RobinhoodError` with `.message`, `.status`, `.body`, and `.requestId` (`_rid`). 429 and 5xx responses are retried automatically with backoff.
